sources.title: GitHub - openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak ...
sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: Whisper Tiny Basque - Proyecto ILENIA
sources.snippet: Whisper Tiny Basque is an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for Basque (eu) speech. It is fine-tuned from [openai/whisper-tiny] on the Basque portion of Mozilla Common Voice 13.0, achieving a Word Error Rate (WER) of 32.27% on the Common Voice evaluation split.

sources.title: whisper-tiny: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-tiny is a 39-parameter Transformer encoder-decoder model from openai trained for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Built on 680k hours of labeled speech data with large-scale weak supervision, the model generalizes across datasets and domains without fine-tuning.
